visual.name: Heat Map
visual.description: A Heatmap is a visual that uses a matrix view to plot values. It helps in detecting the correlation between two categories. Heatmaps are widely used due to their ability to show variance using color gradients. You can make heatmap patterns more prominent by changing the size and shape of the cells.

dataRoles.name: yAxis
dataRoles.description: Position the single/multiple fields on the horizontal X-axis.

dataRoles.name: xAxis
dataRoles.description: Position the single/multiple fields on the vertical Y-Axis.

dataRoles.name: Value
dataRoles.description: Add single/multiple fields to visualize the data.

dataRoles.name: tooltip
dataRoles.description: Include additional Data fields in the tooltip when hovering over specific visual data points.

dataRoles.name: datalabel
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Drag a field to display as a label.

dataRoles.name: colorfield
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Drag a field to display a specific color on the visual.

dataRoles.name: sort
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Drag a field to apply the custom Sorting.

dataRoles.name: showBucket
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Control the visual rendering with a custom condition. Use measure with Boolean logic(1 and 0), where 1 is show and 0 is hide
